name: Zanzibar Plettenberg Bay
address: 3 Crescent St, Plettenberg Bay, 6600, South Africa
description_short: Lively cocktail bar in the heart of Plett, perfect for sundowners and late-night drinks with mates.
description_long:
Tucked on Crescent Street in central Plettenberg Bay, Zanzibar has built a reputation as one of Plett's go-to spots for a proper night out. The vibe is relaxed and social, drawing a mix of locals and holidaymakers who come for well-made cocktails, cold beers, and a buzzing atmosphere that picks up as the evening rolls on.

The bar's central location makes it an easy stop before dinner or the anchor for a longer evening. Bartenders know their way around classic cocktails and local favourites, and the crowd tends to be friendly and up for a good time. Whether you're after sundowners with a view of the street or settling in for live music and dancing, Zanzibar delivers that easygoing Garden Route party spirit.

It's the kind of place that becomes a ritual when you're in town — casual enough for a midweek drink, lively enough for weekend celebrations, and always reliably fun without taking itself too seriously.
